heading: ✨ Upload your menu
intro: A photo of your menu board, a screenshot, a PDF, or paste it as text. Our AI reads it and builds you a working ordering page — your items, your prices — in under 60 seconds. No sign-up, no card.
failedIntro: Sometimes a photo is too dark, too angled, or handwritten. That’s ours to handle, not something you did wrong. A few ways forward:
slow: This is taking longer than usual — big menus sometimes do.
sampleWhileYouWait: Or look round with a sample menu while you wait
standIn: This won’t be your menu — it’s a stand-in so you can see how it works.
orSample: Or look round with a sample menu
orBuild: Or we’ll build it for you
buildSent: ✓ Thanks — we’ve got it. We’ll email you.
buildBody: Leave your email and a real person will put your menu in and send you the link.
noPhoto: Haven’t got a menu photo to hand?
noPhotoBody: Look round with a sample truck instead — you can upload yours any time.
nothingPublished: Nothing is published — only you can see it.

error.somethingWrong: Something went wrong. Please try again.
error.serverUnreachable: We couldn’t reach the server. Check your connection and try again.

fields.dragOrTap: Drag and drop or tap to choose
